Improved progress output:
- The command line now shows a single status line that updates in place instead of printing a new line for every copied chunk and file. It is trimmed to the console width and shows a percentage, and warnings are printed cleanly above it
- Folder datasources such as File Geodatabases (`.gdb`) now show which file inside them is being copied and how far along the folder is, for example `Miskolc_TRE.gdb > a0000000a.gdbtable (37/412 files)`. Sidecar files (such as `.dbf` or `.prj`) are named while they copy. The GUI status line shows the same detail
- When the output is redirected to a file, one line is written per datasource and at most one every five seconds during a long copy, so logs stay short
